nodes.author: dcmohali
nodes.text: After having a review meeting with ADC (Rural Development) Sonam Chaudhary, Assistant Commissioner (G) Dr Ankita Kansal, Civil Surgeon Dr Sangeeta Jain and District Epidemiologist Dr Harman Brar, this afternoon at her office,

nodes.author: dcmohali
nodes.text: she said that the surveillance of flu cases is regularly going on and there is no case of HPMV virus reported so far. She said that the district has a testing facility with Dr B R Ambedkar College of Medical Sciences, Mohali, in case we need it.
